- **Path:** `tests/fixtures/urdf/openrgd_minimal_arm.urdf`
- **Owner:** OpenRGD contributors

The model is intentionally synthetic and minimal. It is not a description of a commercial robot and is not intended for physical actuation. Its only purpose is to provide a hermetic, reviewable fixture whose expected source-derived facts can be asserted in CI.
